title: Depth-three local cohomology vanishing
statement: For a Noetherian local ring R of depth at least three, the second local cohomology module of R supported at its maximal ideal is subsingleton. Here local cohomology is the filtered colimit of Ext^2_R(R/m^n, R) for positive powers of the maximal ideal m. The Noetherian ring uses [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Depth is the regular-sequence depth [def-weil-pbc-depth].

proof.text: Nakayama, in the form Submodule.top_ne_ideal_smul_of_le_jacobson_annihilator, gives mR != R. Unfold the regular-sequence definition of depth. Since 2 < 3 <= depth R, lt_sSup_iff supplies an R-regular sequence rs in m with length greater than two. This needs neither finite depth nor a sequence attaining depth.

For each natural number k, let N = R/m^k. Module.support_eq_zeroLocus and Ideal.annihilator_quotient identify its support with V(m^k). For k != 0, PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus_pow identifies this with V(m); for k = 0 the support is empty. Apply ModuleCat.subsingleton_ext_of_exists_isRegular from Mathlib.RingTheory.Depth.Rees to m, N, R and rs to obtain Subsingleton (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext N R 2). This is the supported-module implication of Rees, and realizes the Ext vanishing step of Stacks Lemma 47.11.1.

Bridge the two Mathlib Ext models in the proved private helper old_ext_two_isZero. Choose the standard projectiveResolution N. ProjectiveResolution.isoExt computes the old Ext module as degree-two homology of the linear Yoneda complex. For every degree-two cocycle f, its derived Ext class P.extMk f is zero by the preceding subsingleton result. ProjectiveResolution.extMk_eq_zero_iff supplies a degree-one cochain g with d followed by g equal to f. ShortComplex.moduleCat_exact_iff proves exactness in degree two, so HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff_isZero_homology proves the old Ext module is zero. No comparison theorem or intermediate statement is left unproved.

Evaluate localCohomology.diagram (idealPowersDiagram m) 2 at ModuleCat.of R R. Every object is zero by the previous steps, hence Functor.isZero_iff makes this evaluated diagram zero. IsColimit.isZero_pt gives its colimit zero. colimitObjIsoColimitCompEvaluation transports this to the evaluation of the colimit defining localCohomology m 2. ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton gives the required subsingleton carrier.

proof_origin.place: Ext vanishing for finite modules supported on V(m), followed by the colimit argument. Agent-written glue extracts a sequence by lt_sSup_iff, compares the two Ext implementations by projective-resolution exactness, and evaluates the colimit.

theorem depth_three_local_cohomology_vanishing
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    (hdepth : (3 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := R) R) :
    Subsingleton ((localCohomology (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) 2).obj
      ((ModuleCat.of R R : ModuleCat.{u} R))).carrier
